entries.headline: Korea and Japan air activity reported at 3.2 times normal
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported military air activity near Korea and Japan at nearly 3.2 times normal and multiple transport and surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States. The visible post is truncated before completing a further reference to a US Navy helicopter.

entries.headline: US transports and elevated Korea-Japan air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported US military transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and air activity near Korea and Japan at nearly three times the usual level. The post does not provide the comparison baseline.

entries.headline: US command, cargo and bomber activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a nuclear command aircraft, three cargo aircraft and a bomber airborne over the continental United States. It also described air activity in the Korea-Japan region as nearly three times usual without providing the comparison baseline.

entries.headline: Korea and Japan air activity and six coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported US Air Force traffic near Korea and Japan at 2.5 times normal levels and six coded radio broadcasts across US skies during the preceding hour. The post does not provide the comparison baseline or broadcast contents.

entries.headline: Coded broadcasts reported at nearly six times normal across nine regions
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported US Air Force coded radio broadcasts at nearly six times normal across nine global regions, naming the Middle East, Europe and Asia-Pacific. The visible post is truncated before completing a further reference to nuclear command activity.

entries.headline: US military activity reported across five regions
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported increased US military activity across five regions, including the continental United States, with nuclear command aircraft and transport aircraft airborne and coded radio broadcasts ongoing. The post does not state its comparison baseline.

entries.headline: Four coded broadcasts and US military aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported four coded US Air Force radio broadcasts within the preceding hour, with multiple transport and surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States. The post does not provide the broadcast contents.

entries.headline: Six military transports and nuclear command aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six military transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the United States. It described the transport count as above the usual level for that hour without providing the comparison baseline.

entries.headline: Six US transports over North Atlantic and US reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the North Atlantic and United States. It also reported a surveillance aircraft and two nuclear command aircraft seen during the preceding few hours.

entries.headline: Six US transports and earlier command-aircraft sightings reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and North Sea. It also reported two nuclear command aircraft seen earlier near the US East Coast.

entries.headline: US transports and command aircraft reported; no significant coded traffic
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the North Sea and United States, along with a nuclear command-and-control aircraft. It said no significant coded broadcasts had been detected that day.

entries.headline: US transports and surveillance aircraft reported over UK and North Sea
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft and a surveillance aircraft airborne over the United Kingdom and North Sea. It identified several as large strategic-airlift cargo aircraft.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on BAE F-35 electronic-warfare order
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that BAE Systems received an order from Lockheed Martin to supply electronic-warfare systems for F-35 production Lots 20 through 22. The post does not state the order value or delivery schedule.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on first F-16 Block 72 flight
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The War Zone report that the first F-16 Block 72 completed its maiden flight and identified Morocco as the launch customer. The post does not provide further flight details.

entries.headline: B-52 airborne alert at Midwest City
